config_name: iPad Pro 11-inch — M5 (9-core CPU/10-core GPU), 12GB RAM, 256GB SSD, 11" Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED + Magic Keyboard

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard included in price: scissor keys (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total

battery.notes: Apple claims 10h web/video on Wi-Fi. Users report ~8-9h mixed real-world use; 11" cell slightly smaller.

price.notes: Tablet-only $1,699.99 (BBY 19495711 / apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard 11" $399.99 (BBY 17932865). Apple Pencil Pro $168.99 not included.

offers.name: Apple iPad Pro M5 11" 256GB with Wi-Fi (6th Generation) - Space Black

reviews.quote: An extremely fast M5 SoC and Wi-Fi 7. Pros: extremely fast M5 SoC, sturdy and timeless case, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G, good camera quality for a tablet, powerful speaker sound, comprehensive software package, good battery life, bright and accurate display. Cons: no power adapter included, very expensive, PWM flickering, no always-on display, only a 12-month warranty. (NBC review of the iPad Pro 11" M5 2025, 90% very good; same SoC and panel family across 11"/13" tiers.)

praises: Best size/weight balance in the Pro line — 444g tablet that genuinely travels (r/ipad owners who downgraded from 13")
Tandem OLED with 1000-nit SDR and 120Hz ProMotion on an 11" panel is superb for its class
M5 is faster than most thin-and-light laptops in short bursts; huge GPU uplift over M4
Magic Keyboard 11" makes it the closest thing to a true netbook-replacement that just works
Apple Pencil Pro hover + squeeze is great for on-the-go sketching and markup
complaints: iPadOS is the bottleneck: no full desktop-class apps (real Excel, Xcode, DAWs), file management friction — #1 Reddit gripe
On 11" the split-screen/Stage Manager real estate is tight for keyboard+laptop use
Magic Keyboard $399.99 with unlit keys is an accessory tax on a $2,100 setup
Apple Pencil Pro sold separately ($168.99-199) on a Pro device enrages buyers
256GB base feels small for a Pro; single USB-C port and no headphone jack

design_philosophy: Apple's halo tablet in its most portable form: identical M5 silicon and tandem OLED technology as the 13" at a third less volume, which most users actually carry. This entry tier takes the M5 experience to its lowest price point with storage as the only compromise. With the Magic Keyboard priced in it is the smallest true laptop-alternative Apple sells — minus desktop-app parity.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Pro M5 13" (90%, gap-fill 2026-11-24).
